sentences.text: Yes: for EMI-based personal loans, the Reserve Bank circular says that at the time of reset of interest rates, REs shall provide borrowers the option to switch over to a fixed rate as per their Board-approved policy.
The bank’s own retail loan policy is narrower in wording because it says the Bank may, at its option, offer the borrower a choice to switch to a fixed rate at the time of reset of the floating rate.
The later RBI amendment text available here is not yet in force, and it also uses permissive wording about providing the fixed-rate switch option.
